purpose: Human-readable terminal-style log format for the construction demo.
principles: Every displayed log line should be a string, not raw JSON.
Use a Linux terminal / multi-service log style: relative time, actor, vertical divider, event label, message.
Keep normal events as one line.
Render tool and skill events as a main line plus indented sublines.
Make TOOL and SKILL visually scannable without requiring the viewer to understand internal system names.
Use demo vocabulary such as subtask, region, foreman, worker, tool, and skill.

time.note: Relative time is for pacing only; exact timestamps are not important in the demo.

actor.note: Use full display names in demo logs. Short codes such as PM, F-03, and W-047 may exist internally, but should not be used in the visible log line.

normalLog.description: Single-line event for planning, assignment, progress, synchronization, and completion.

labels.WARN: Recoverable problem that leads to repair.

examples: T+00.42  ProjectManager │ PLAN  blueprint loaded · xini.json · 95,151 blocks · 52 levels
T+02.10  Foreman-03     │ TASK  group C assigned · workers 041-060 · target 486 subtasks
T+06.20  Foreman-03     │ PROG  group C [█████░░░░░] 214/486 · active workers 20
T+12.40  ProjectManager │ SYNC  collected reports · 5 foremen · 100 workers · 72% complete
T+04.16  Worker-052     │ WARN  D-021 mismatch · 2 missing · 1 wrong
T+05.33  Worker-052     │ PASS  D-021 verified after patch · accepted

toolLog.description: Three-line event that shows a tool call and its input/result as sublines.

states.TOOL▶: Tool is being called or starts execution.
states.TOOL✕: Tool completed with a recoverable failure.

skillLog.description: Three-line event for learning, publishing, broadcasting, and using skills.

states.SKILL◆: A new reusable skill has been learned or improved.
states.SKILL↗: A skill is published or broadcast to downstream agents.
states.SKILL▶: A worker starts using a skill.

examples: T+08.50  ProjectManager │ SKILL◆ Learned Build Region v1
T+08.92  ProjectManager │ SKILL↗ Published Build Region v1
└─ result  skill available for regional execution
T+09.31  Foreman-03     │ SKILL↗ Broadcast Build Region v1
T+10.04  Worker-047     │ SKILL▶ Use Build Region v1
└─ result  completed from learned pattern · verified
